format:
<body>
<button class="md-raised md-button md-ink-ripple" onclick="importData()">Upload</button>    

<script>
let restoreScope = scope;

function importData() {
  let input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.id = 'restoreBtn';
  input.onchange = _ => {
    // you can use this method to get file and perform respective operations
        let fReader = new FileReader();
        fReader.readAsText(input.files[0]);
        fReader.onloadend = function(event){
        restoreScope.send({payload:event.target.result});}
        };
  input.click();
}
</script>
</body>

  for (let i = 0; i < point.registers; i += 1) words.push(wordAt(offset + i));
  let value;
  if (point.kind === "float32") {
    value = Buffer.from(bytesFor(words, point.order)).readFloatBE(0);
  } else if (point.kind === "float64") {
    const pairs = bytesFor(words.slice(0, 2), point.order).concat(bytesFor(words.slice(2, 4), point.order));
    value = Buffer.from(pairs).readDoubleBE(0);
  } else if (point.kind === "int16") {
    value = words[0] & 0x8000 ? words[0] - 0x10000 : words[0];
  } else if (point.kind === "uint16") {
    value = words[0];
  } else if (point.kind === "int32" || point.kind === "uint32") {
    const buffer = Buffer.from(bytesFor(words, point.order));
    value = point.kind === "int32" ? buffer.readInt32BE(0) : buffer.readUInt32BE(0);
  } else {
    value = words[0];
  }
  if (Number.isFinite(value)) value = value * point.scale + point.offset;
  return value;
}

for (const id of block.pointIds) {
  const point = pointsById[id];
  if (!point) continue;
  const offset = point.address - block.start;
  if (offset < 0 || offset >= registers.length) continue;
  const value = decodeValue(point, offset);
  updates[point.name] = value;
  if (point.duplicateBase) {
    duplicateGroups[point.duplicateBase] = duplicateGroups[point.duplicateBase] || [];
    duplicateGroups[point.duplicateBase].push(value);
  }
}

for (const [baseName, values] of Object.entries(duplicateGroups)) {
  if (baseName.endsWith("开关") || baseName.endsWith("启动故障")) {
    updates[baseName] = values.some((value) => Number(value) === 1) ? 1 : 0;
  } else if (!(baseName in updates)) {
    updates[baseName] = values.find((value) => value !== undefined && value !== null);
  }
}

const dateTime = new Date().toLocaleString('zh-cn', { hour12: false });
updates.DateTime = dateTime;

global.set("间歇运行", Object.assign({}, global.get("间歇运行") || {}, {
  "PLC数据获取时间": dateTime
}));

const raw = Object.assign({}, global.get("PLC原始数据") || {}, updates);
global.set("PLC原始数据", raw);
global.set("PLC", raw);
global.set("张家港Modbus原始数据", raw);

const categoryNames = ["开关", "频率", "电功率", "温度", "湿度", "压力", "流量", "电流百分比", "调节阀开度"];
for (const category of categoryNames) {
  const current = Object.assign({}, global.get(category) || {});
  current.DateTime = dateTime;
  
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(updates)) {
    if (name.includes(category)) current[name] = value;
  }
  global.set(category, current);
}

msg.payload = raw;
msg.modbusUpdates = updates;
msg.topic = "PLC原始数据";
return msg;

name: 说明
info:
1. 本版本兼容 node-red-contrib-modbus 5.x，节点类型是 modbus-client + modbus-flex-getter。
2. 导入后修改配置节点“张家港Modbus Client-请修改IP”的 tcpHost、tcpPort、unit_id。
3. inject 默认每秒读一个采集块；23 个采集块约 23 秒刷新一轮，可按现场通讯能力调小 repeat。
4. 本流程只负责读 ModbusTCP，并写入 global.PLC原始数据 / global.PLC / 开关 / 频率 / 电功率等变量。
